implemented: canonical tamper-evident snapshots for definition-grounded predicate lexemes
snapshot schema, entry validation, deterministic ordering, duplicate rejection, and SHA-256 integrity verification
snapshot export and import through the cognitive language boundary
ordered compositional goal graphs for Korean and English compound requests
sequence and coordination edges between independently grounded goals

architecture.language_reasoning_path: surface -> compositional frames/scopes -> interpretation candidates -> ordered goal graph -> GoalIR plan -> existing reasoner
architecture.predicate_learning_path: definition-grounded lexeme -> validated canonical snapshot -> verified import -> existing compositional scope rules

non_gating_all_features_observation.cause: semantic-reasoning includes SEM-26 types through two module identities under the all-features combination; the default workspace build and all 595 tests pass

development_counterexamples.observed: A condition on a later Korean goal initially made the preceding completed goal hypothetical.
development_counterexamples.repair: Bound conditional scope after the preceding coordinator boundary instead of applying it sentence-wide.

development_counterexamples.observed: The noun 보고서 was initially split as the reporting predicate 보고 plus a nominal suffix.
development_counterexamples.repair: Required a recognized Korean verbal inflection boundary for embedded action stems.

development_counterexamples.observed: The past counterfactual 지웠더라면 was lost by the stricter morphology boundary, while a vacuous unit assertion still passed.
development_counterexamples.repair: Added the counterfactual inflection boundary and required the regression test to prove that a blocked candidate actually exists.

development_counterexamples.observed: A command inside Korean curly quotation marks was not recognized as a non-authoritative mention.
development_counterexamples.repair: Made Unicode quotation marks valid lexical delimiters and added a dedicated regression test.

known_limits: This remains a deterministic bilingual structural language cortex, not a pretrained general language model.
Goal-graph conditions are retained as explicit textual constraints but are not yet lowered into a complete logical proposition graph.
Long-distance dependency structure, quantifier scope, ellipsis, and nested coreference remain incomplete.
Learned predicate snapshots have explicit import and export APIs but no automatic durable store lifecycle yet.
Only controlled Korean and English cases have been measured; there is no large frozen open-domain benchmark.
The repository all-features Clippy combination has a separate SEM-26 module-identity defect even though the default workspace passes.
next_frontier: dependency and semantic-role graphs for nested clauses
